    Class TpVideoPlayer

    Plays native video files and YouTube videos with a common playback API.

    Example

    <tp-video-player src="/docs/components/video-player/examples/clip-1.mp4" controls label="Moving shapes"></tp-video-player>

    Tagname

    tp-video-player

    Attr

    src = "" - Native media URL or YouTube watch, share, shorts, live or embed URL. Changing it loads the new video from the beginning.

    Attr

    poster = "" - Image shown before native video playback; YouTube supplies its own preview.

    Attr

    label = "Video" - Accessible name for the native video or YouTube iframe.

    Attr

    controls = false - Shows the provider's playback controls. YouTube may still display its initial Play button.

    Attr

    autoplay = false - Requests playback when the source loads; browser autoplay restrictions still apply.

    Attr

    muted = false - Mutes the video, including when changed during playback.

    Attr

    loop = false - Repeats the video; a looping video does not normally emit ended.

    Attr

    preload = "metadata" - Native video preload hint. YouTube loading is controlled by its embedded player. tp-video-player-ready Emitted when native metadata or the YouTube player is ready.

    Eventdetail

    tp-video-player-ready { src: string; provider: "native" | "youtube" | "" } tp-video-player-play Emitted when playback starts.

    Eventdetail

    tp-video-player-play { src: string; provider: "native" | "youtube" | "" } tp-video-player-pause Emitted when playback pauses.

    Eventdetail

    tp-video-player-pause { src: string; provider: "native" | "youtube" | "" } tp-video-player-ended Emitted when a non-looping video reaches its end.

    Eventdetail

    tp-video-player-ended { src: string; provider: "native" | "youtube" | "" } tp-video-player-error Emitted when a source is invalid, unavailable or playback fails.

    Eventdetail

    tp-video-player-error { src: string; provider: "native" | "youtube" | ""; message: string; code?: number } tp-video-player-autoplay-blocked Emitted when YouTube blocks a playback request. Native play() rejects its promise when blocked.

    Eventdetail

    tp-video-player-autoplay-blocked { src: string; provider: "native" | "youtube" | "" }

    Accessibility

    Retains native or YouTube controls and labels the active media surface.

    Accessibilityresponsibility

    Supply captions in the video source/provider and a meaningful label.
